title: Typing indicator
summary: Shows who is typing in the open chat, above the composer, and tells the others when the person types.

typingNames.description: From the typing listener, without the person's own user ID.

observe.effect: Room.subscribeToTypingNotifications while the chat is open; drops the subscription when it closes.

typed.effect: On composer change: Room.typingNotice(true), at most every 4 s. On send, on a blank composer or after 5 s without typing: Room.typingNotice(false).

notes: One name: bipe_app_typing_one. Two: bipe_app_typing_two. Three or more: bipe_app_typing_many. In a DM the line shows no name, only the animated dots and bipe_app_typing_one as the accessibility label.
Typing notices are not encrypted in Matrix. Phase 1 always sends them; a setting to turn them off is out of scope.
